simple.meaning: יְהוּדִית (Yᵉhûwdîyth) is a Hebrew word meaning “the Jewish (used adverbially) language.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יְהוּדִית (H3066) appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Kings 18:26, with occurrences in 2 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Nehemiah, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יְהוּדִית (H3066) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יְהוּדִית (H3066) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יְהוּדִית (Yᵉhûwdîyth) / H3066 is traced through 2 Kings 18:26, 2 Kings 18:28, 2 Chronicles 32:18, Nehemiah 13:24 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H3066. Yehudith I. יְהוּדִית adjective, of a people, feminine of foregoing, but only as adverb in Jewish = in the Jewish language 2Kin 18:26 , 28 = Isa 36:11 , 13 2Chr 32:18 ; Neh 13:24 .
